note: Eleventh shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the perfumery and fashion boutique, with violet walls and a parquet floor inlaid with a big compass star. LANDMARK: the round glass dome over the tall curved oak shelves of perfume bottles. The arch on the left shows the red print room with its iron press (way back); the tall doorway on the right opens onto the glass-roofed trading hall (next). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right. Zooms: the glass jewel cabinet (z1) and the watchman's desk with its lantern (z2).
